newsitem.title: UK: Demand is selective in dull European raw cotton.
newsitem.headline: Demand is selective in dull European raw cotton.

text.p: Monday's strong showing by the US dollar meant that currency considerations stayed in the foreground in several European raw cotton markets that otherwise lacked any fundamental new feature.
Mill demand was again selective and directed mainly toward Central Asian styles available for shipment during the second and third quarters of the year.

Limited interest has also been evident for growths such as West African and Syrian. The latter origin has largely been disregarded on price considerations. Overall the market lacked impetus and the volume of new mill purchases seemed limited.
